verses.text: Jehovah, thou hast been favorable unto thy land; Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

segments.text: Jehovah, thou hast been favorable unto thy land;
Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

verses.text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; Thou hast covered all their sin. [Selah

segments.text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people;
Thou hast covered all their sin. [Selah

verses.text: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath; Thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

segments.text: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath;
Thou hast turned
thyself
from the fierceness of thine anger.

verses.text: Turn us, O God of our salvation, And cause thine indignation toward us to cease.

segments.text: Turn us, O God of our salvation,
And cause thine indignation toward us to cease.

verses.text: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

segments.text: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever?
Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

verses.text: Wilt thou not quicken us again, That thy people may rejoice in thee?

segments.text: Wilt thou not quicken us again,
That thy people may rejoice in thee?

verses.text: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.

segments.text: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah,
And grant us thy salvation.

verses.text: I will hear what God Jehovah will speak; For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.

segments.text: I will hear what God Jehovah will speak;
For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints:
But let them not turn again to folly.

verses.text: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, That glory may dwell in our land.

segments.text: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him,
That glory may dwell in our land.

verses.text: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

segments.text: Mercy and truth are met together;
Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.text: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

segments.text: Truth springeth out of the earth;
And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

verses.text: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good; And our land shall yield its increase.

segments.text: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good;
And our land shall yield its increase.

verses.text: Righteousness shall go before him, And shall make his footsteps a way to walk in.

segments.text: Righteousness shall go before him,
And shall make his footsteps a way
to walk in

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
